caption:
सलमान खान ही हैं असली प्रेम, आयुष्मान खुराना ने कह दी बड़ी बात! 🎬

मुंबई में Yeh Prem Mol Liya फिल्म के trailer launch पर आयुष्मान खुराना नजर आए। 🍿

फिल्म में वह प्रेम का किरदार निभा रहे हैं, जिसे सलमान खान ने कई फिल्मों में निभाया है। 🎥

आयुष्मान का कहना है कि सलमान भाई से बेहतर प्रेम कोई नहीं हो सकता और हम सब उन्हें आइडियल मानते हैं। 🙌

साथ ही उन्होंने कहा कि प्रेम होना बहुत बड़ी जिम्मेदारी है, वह संवेदनशील, दयालु और इमोशनली उपलब्ध होता है। ❤️

डायरेक्टर सूरज बड़जात्या का कहना है कि आयुष्मान का प्रेम अपने तरीके से स्टैंड लेता है और उन्होंने बहुत ही शानदार काम किया है। 🌟

Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani से तुलना पर आयुष्मान ने बताया कि करण जौहर ने सबसे पहले मैसेज किया था और प्रेम शुरू से ही green forest रहा है, इसलिए तुलना नहीं हो सकती। 🙅‍♂️

को-स्टार सीमा पाहवा का कहना है कि ऐसी कहानियां हर घर में प्रासंगिक हैं। 🏡

यह फिल्म 27 नवंबर को theaters में रिलीज हो रही है, जिसमें आयुष्मान और शर्वरी लीड रोल में हैं। 🎟️

क्या आप सिनेमाघरों में Yeh Prem Mol Liya देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? 💭

ctx.title: ‘Salman Khan is the OG Prem,’ says Ayushmann Khurrana: ‘We idealise him’
ctx.text:
Ayushmann Khurrana will soon be seen in Sooraj Barjatya’s Yeh Prem Mol Liya and the actor was present at the trailer launch of the film at an event in Mumbai. Here, he is essaying Prem, a character who has been played by Salman Khan in many of Sooraj’s films. While Shahid Kapoor, Abhishek Bachchan and Hrithik Roshan have also played the character in Vivah and Main Prem Ki Diwani Hoon, it is Salman Khan who is prominently associated with the character.
Ayushmann opened up about the expected comparison with Salman and said, “Firstly, nobody can be a better Prem than Salman Bhai. He is the OG Prem. We all idealise him as Prem.”

He further added, “Being Prem is a huge responsibility. You have to walk the talk. You need to understand what a perfect man would be like. He is sensitive, kind, and emotionally available. This world needs a Prem, and we are bringing one.”
Sooraj Barjatya pointed out the differences between Salman and Ayushmann’s interpretation of Prem and said, “This Prem takes a stand in his tender way. The first time this subject came to me, Ayushmann was in my mind. If you see his films, he has such simplicity, and it’s evident in the films he does. The similarity between Salman and him is that I let them be the way they are. On the first day, Ayushmann got the pulse of Prem so well, that I didn’t want to touch it. Same with Salman Bhai, I narrate and he turns the scene in his way and that’s his version of Prem. But Ayushmann has done an exceptional job. He is different from all the Prems I have done.”
While in the trailer, Ayushmann Khurrana’s character is seen bringing his family and his in-laws under the same roof, the film could remind viewers of Karan Johar’s Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani .
Talking about these comparisons, Ayushmann said, “Karan Johar was the first one to message us after seeing the first look. He was in love with Sooraj Barjatya’s world. Prem has been a green forest from the beginning. He takes a stand for his wife. Rocky’s character arc was very different. So you cannot compare.”
Ayushmann’s co-star Seema Pahwa also added, “These stories are relevant in every household, so how can we compare? This is made by Soorajji, hence it’s different.”
Yeh Prem Mol Liya releases in theaters on November 27. The film stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari in the lead roles. Anupam Kher, Seema Pahwa, Supriya Pathak, Saumya Tandon, Swanand Kirkire, and Geeta Aggarwal will be seen in important roles.
